stories.title: Trump onverstaanbaar bij mediamoment, media blijven weg en tonen zich solidair met CNN

en.title: Trump unintelligible at media moment, media stay away and show solidarity with CNN
en.summary: President Trump opened a new helicopter landing site at the White House on Monday. Multiple media outlets were absent from the event and demonstrated support for CNN.

stories.title: Privacytoezichthouder: mensen filmen met camerabril mag vrijwel nooit

en.title: Privacy regulator: filming people with camera glasses is almost never permitted
en.summary: The Dutch Data Protection Authority warns that footage recorded with camera glasses cannot be freely used, shared, or published without consent. The authority recommends organizations prohibit camera glass usage.

stories.title: Ook Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens waarschuwt voor ‘gluurbrillen’: anderen filmen met camerabril is ‘vrijwel altijd verboden’

en.title: Data Protection Authority also warns against 'spy glasses': filming others with camera glasses is 'almost always forbidden'
en.summary: The Data Protection Authority has issued a warning that recording others with camera glasses is prohibited in nearly all circumstances.

stories.title: Geveilde spullen Brigitte Bardot leveren twintig keer zoveel op als gedacht

en.title: Brigitte Bardot auction items raise twenty times more than expected
en.summary: Personal belongings of late actress and activist Brigitte Bardot sold at auction in Paris for nearly 954,000 euros, roughly twenty times the pre-sale estimate of 50,000 euros. The 280 items included dog collars, a self-portrait, typewriter, furniture, clothing, and other personal possessions.

stories.title: Trump onverstaanbaar of helemaal niet in beeld: nieuwszenders VS tonen zich solidair met geboycot CNN

en.title: Trump inaudible or completely absent: US news broadcasters show solidarity with CNN boycott
en.summary: US news broadcasters have shown solidarity by boycotting coverage related to Trump, with networks either airing inaudible segments or not covering him at all in response to CNN's boycott action.

stories.title: Paramount schikt met Amerikaanse staten die overname Warner Bros hadden aangevochten

en.title: Paramount settles with American states that challenged Warner Bros acquisition
en.summary: Paramount Skydance has reached a settlement with twelve US states that sought to block its acquisition of Warner Bros Discovery, which states opposed due to competition and employment concerns.

stories.title: Grote brand bij afvalverwerker in Gelderse Dinxperlo onder controle

en.title: Large fire at waste processor in Dutch Dinxperlo brought under control
en.summary: A fire at a waste processing facility in Dinxperlo involving wood and garden waste has been contained, with firefighters conducting mop-up operations while a nearby fuel station was secured.

stories.title: Bijna miljoen euro voor veiling spullen Brigitte Bardot, 20 keer meer dan verwacht

en.title: Nearly one million euros raised at Brigitte Bardot memorabilia auction, 20 times expected amount
en.summary: An auction of Brigitte Bardot's personal belongings and memorabilia in Paris raised nearly 954,000 euros, approximately twenty times the estimated value of around 50,000 euros.

stories.title: Grote brand bij afvalverwerker in Dinxperlo onder controle, brandweer blust na

en.title: Large fire at waste processor in Dinxperlo brought under control, fire service extinguishes
en.summary: A major fire broke out Monday evening at a waste processing facility in Dinxperlo, involving waste piles measuring approximately 20 by 30 meters. Firefighters had the blaze under control by around 00.40.

stories.title: Twee mannen veroordeeld voor ernstige mishandeling dorpsgenoot die vóór asielopvang pleitte

en.title: Two men convicted of serious assault on village resident who advocated for asylum reception
en.summary: Two men have been convicted of severely assaulting a fellow villager who had spoken in favor of asylum housing facilities.

stories.title: Grote Amerikaanse omroepen tonen zich solidair met uit het Witte Huis verbannen media

en.title: Major American broadcasters show solidarity with media banned from the White House
en.summary: Major American media outlets expressed support for news organizations that were denied access to the White House.

stories.title: Taakstraf voor mannen die vrouw mishandelden rond onrust asielopvang Engelen

en.title: Community service for men who assaulted woman during unrest over asylum shelter in Engelen
en.summary: A district court in Den Bosch sentenced two men, aged 41 and 43, to community service for assaulting a woman. The men claimed the victim had sabotaged protests against an asylum facility opening in Engelen.
